name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted WhatsApp API gateway with REST API, webhooks and web dashboard, storing data in SQLite on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Sign in to the dashboard with the API_MASTER_KEY value from the environment variables. It is the first admin API key and is only applied on the first start.
OpenWA uses unofficial WhatsApp clients, so a linked number can be restricted or banned. Link a dedicated number, not your primary one.
